title: Making change
description:
Give change with as few coins as possible, the greedy way, and see when greedy fails.

```
coins 1 2 5 10 20 50, amount 87: 50 20 10 5 2 (5 coins)
coins 1 3 4, amount 6: greedy 4 1 1 (3 coins), best 3 3 (2 coins)
```
hints: Sort the coins from largest down and, for each, take it while it fits (lesson 6.01).
Greedy works for most real coin systems, but not for every set; 1, 3, 4 with 6 is the classic counterexample.
requirements: `greedyChange(coins, amount)` takes the largest coin that fits, again and again.
`bestChange(coins, amount)` tries every combination for small amounts (or use the DP from the next project).
Print both for the two coin sets.
stretch: Prove to yourself why greedy is right for 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50.
